claim_scores.rationale: Uses `dspy.LM(..., model_type="responses")` and patches `litellm.responses` to capture the outbound responses-mode request.
Passes a multi-turn `messages=` list including a multimodal user turn with both `text` and `image_url` content items.
Reads `mock_responses.call_args.kwargs["input"]`, prints it, and asserts on that exact payload structure.
Asserts `len(payload) == 1` and that the single item's role is `user`, matching the last original message and demonstrating flattening.
Asserts the ordered `input_text` blocks contain all text from string and multimodal text message bodies in sequence.
Asserts one `input_image` block is present and that its `image_url` equals the original nested URL string.
